decisions.docsAuthority: src/mcp/tools/bb_ask/descriptor.ts + script/tool-docs/curation/bb_ask.ts are the source; docs/tools/bb_ask.md is generated
decisions.guideTruth: every measured rule the guide states is one a behavioural gate asserts (page size 1..100/default 5, similarity floors, per-space coverage, scan cap 20,000, provider wait ceiling 2 s, STALE vs MISSING)
decisions.laneEvidence: validation/tools/bb_ask/gates/summary.json must show the other ask gates verified
decisions.releaseGate: the release validator blocks a tampered verified claim — proven against the real validator

limitations: Page byte-freshness is proven by the generator's own verify mode for this tool only (the campaign regenerates shared artifacts centrally).
Lane evidence is produced by validation/tools/bb_ask/work/run-gates.mjs; this gate reads it rather than trusting the tree.
